evd_title: OpenAI o3 achieved the highest hit rate of 48.2% (PDF) and 50.6% (LaTeX) among all reasoning LLMs tested as scientific paper quality checkers
finding: OpenAI o3 achieved the highest hit rate of 48.2% (PDF) and 50.6% (LaTeX) among all reasoning LLMs tested as scientific paper quality checkers
P: 245 withdrawn arXiv papers with author-stated critical errors (WithdrarXiv-Check test set; Math 52%, Physics 29%, CS 15%)
I: o3 (2025-04-16, medium reasoning), zero-shot fixed prompt, up to 5 problems; PDF attachment or LaTeX in prompt
C: Gemini 2.5 Pro, Gemini 2.5 Flash, o4-mini, Claude 3.7 Sonnet; gold errors judged by Gemini 2.5 Pro + o3
O: PRECIS-2 weighted kappa 0.01 (Claude-2) to 0.12 (Claude-3-Opus) vs human rater 1 weighted kappa 0.57; accuracy 38-55% vs 75%
T: Papers withdrawn from arXiv 2007-2024 (by Sep 2024); models run early May 2025; paper 2025
